coveragePolicy.purpose: Ensure future chats and agents recognize the combined moving-main plus pre-run CI queue state without re-diagnosing it from scratch.
coveragePolicy.reuseRule: Load the canonical learning record and existing prevention rules before attempting recovery.
coveragePolicy.truthRule: A queued workflow with no runner execution has no test conclusion; current-main ancestry and exact-head evidence must both be current before protected merge.
coveragePolicy.sensitiveDataRule: Only bounded repository metadata, fingerprints and evidence references are stored.
